38.text: Jesus turned and saw them following, and said to them, “What are you looking for?” They said to him, “Rabbi” (which is to say, being interpreted, Teacher), “where are you staying?”

39.text: He said to them, “Come, and see.” They came and saw where he was staying, and they stayed with him that day. It was about the tenth hour.

42.text: He brought him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him, and said, “You are Simon the son of Jonah. You shall be called Cephas” (which is by interpretation, Peter).

43.text: On the next day, he was determined to go out into Galilee, and he found Philip. Jesus said to him, “Follow me.”

47.text: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and said about him, “Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!”

48.text: Nathanael said to him, “How do you know me?” Jesus answered him, “Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you.”

50.text: Jesus answered him, “Because I told you, ‘I saw you underneath the fig tree,’ do you believe? You will see greater things than these!”

51.text: He said to him, “Most certainly, I tell you all, hereafter you will see heaven opened, and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.”

4.text: Jesus said to her, “Woman, what does that have to do with you and me? My hour has not yet come.”

7.text: Jesus said to them, “Fill the water pots with water.” So they filled them up to the brim.

8.text: He said to them, “Now draw some out, and take it to the ruler of the feast.” So they took it.

16.text: To those who sold the doves, he said, “Take these things out of here! Don’t make my Father’s house a marketplace!”

19.text: Jesus answered them, “Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.”

3.text: Jesus answered him, “Most certainly, I tell you, unless one is born anew, he can’t see God’s Kingdom.”

5.text: Jesus answered, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born of water and spirit, he can’t enter into God’s Kingdom.

6.text: That which is born of the flesh is flesh. That which is born of the Spirit is spirit.

7.text: Don’t marvel that I said to you, ‘You must be born anew.’

8.text: The wind blows where it wants to, and you hear its sound, but don’t know where it comes from and where it is going. So is everyone who is born of the Spirit.”

10.text: Jesus answered him, “Are you the teacher of Israel, and don’t understand these things?

11.text: Most certainly I tell you, we speak that which we know, and testify of that which we have seen, and you don’t receive our witness.

12.text: If I told you earthly things and you don’t believe, how will you believe if I tell you heavenly things?

13.text: No one has ascended into heaven but he who descended out of heaven, the Son of Man, who is in heaven.

14.text: As Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of Man be lifted up,

15.text: that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

16.text: For God so loved the world, that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

17.text: For God didn’t send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.

18.text: He who believes in him is not judged. He who doesn’t believe has been judged already, because he has not believed in the name of the one and only Son of God.

19.text: This is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light; for their works were evil.

20.text: For everyone who does evil hates the light, and doesn’t come to the light, lest his works would be exposed.

21.text: But he who does the truth comes to the light, that his works may be revealed, that they have been done in God.”

7.text: A woman of Samaria came to draw water. Jesus said to her, “Give me a drink.”

10.text: Jesus answered her, “If you knew the gift of God, and who it is who says to you, ‘Give me a drink,’ you would have asked him, and he would have given you living water.”

13.text: Jesus answered her, “Everyone who drinks of this water will thirst again,

14.text: but whoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never thirst again; but the water that I will give him will become in him a well of water springing up to eternal life.”

16.text: Jesus said to her, “Go, call your husband, and come here.”

17.text: The woman answered, “I have no husband.” Jesus said to her, “You said well, ‘I have no husband,’

18.text: for you have had five husbands; and he whom you now have is not your husband. This you have said truly.”

21.text: Jesus said to her, “Woman, believe me, the hour comes, when neither in this mountain, nor in Jerusalem, will you worship the Father.

22.text: You worship that which you don’t know. We worship that which we know; for salvation is from the Jews.

23.text: But the hour comes, and now is, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for the Father seeks such to be his worshipers.

24.text: God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.”

26.text: Jesus said to her, “I am he, the one who speaks to you.”

32.text: But he said to them, “I have food to eat that you don’t know about.”

34.text: Jesus said to them, “My food is to do the will of him who sent me and to accomplish his work.

35.text: Don’t you say, ‘There are yet four months until the harvest?’ Behold, I tell you, lift up your eyes and look at the fields, that they are white for harvest already.

36.text: He who reaps receives wages and gathers fruit to eternal life; that both he who sows and he who reaps may rejoice together.

37.text: For in this the saying is true, ‘One sows, and another reaps.’

38.text: I sent you to reap that for which you haven’t labored. Others have labored, and you have entered into their labor.”

48.text: Jesus therefore said to him, “Unless you see signs and wonders, you will in no way believe.”

50.text: Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your son lives.” The man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him, and he went his way.

53.text: So the father knew that it was at that hour in which Jesus said to him, “Your son lives.” He believed, as did his whole house.

6.text: When Jesus saw him lying there, and knew that he had been sick for a long time, he asked him, “Do you want to be made well?”

8.text: Jesus said to him, “Arise, take up your mat, and walk.”

14.text: Afterward Jesus found him in the temple, and said to him, “Behold, you are made well. Sin no more, so that nothing worse happens to you.”

17.text: But Jesus answered them, “My Father is still working, so I am working, too.”

19.text: Jesus therefore answered them, “Most certainly, I tell you, the Son can do nothing of himself, but what he sees the Father doing. For whatever things he does, these the Son also does likewise.

20.text: For the Father has affection for the Son, and shows him all things that he himself does. He will show him greater works than these, that you may marvel.

21.text: For as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, even so the Son also gives life to whom he desires.

22.text: For the Father judges no one, but he has given all judgment to the Son,

23.text: that all may honor the Son, even as they honor the Father. He who doesn’t honor the Son doesn’t honor the Father who sent him.

24.text: “Most certainly I tell you, he who hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life, and doesn’t come into judgment, but has passed out of death into life.

25.text: Most certainly I tell you, the hour comes, and now is, when the dead will hear the Son of God’s voice; and those who hear will live.

26.text: For as the Father has life in himself, even so he gave to the Son also to have life in himself.

27.text: He also gave him authority to execute judgment, because he is a son of man.

28.text: Don’t marvel at this, for the hour comes in which all who are in the tombs will hear his voice,

29.text: and will come out; those who have done good, to the resurrection of life; and those who have done evil, to the resurrection of judgment.

30.text: I can of myself do nothing. As I hear, I judge, and my judgment is righteous; because I don’t seek my own will, but the will of my Father who sent me.

31.text: “If I testify about myself, my witness is not valid.

32.text: It is another who testifies about me. I know that the testimony which he testifies about me is true.

33.text: You have sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.

34.text: But the testimony which I receive is not from man. However, I say these things that you may be saved.

35.text: He was the burning and shining lamp, and you were willing to rejoice for a while in his light.

36.text: But the testimony which I have is greater than that of John, for the works which the Father gave me to accomplish, the very works that I do, testify about me, that the Father has sent me.

37.text: The Father himself, who sent me, has testified about me. You have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his form.

38.text: You don’t have his word living in you, because you don’t believe him whom he sent.

39.text: “You search the Scriptures, because you think that in them you have eternal life; and these are they which testify about me.

40.text: Yet you will not come to me, that you may have life.

41.text: I don’t receive glory from men.

42.text: But I know you, that you don’t have God’s love in yourselves.

43.text: I have come in my Father’s name, and you don’t receive me. If another comes in his own name, you will receive him.

44.text: How can you believe, who receive glory from one another, and you don’t seek the glory that comes from the only God?

45.text: “Don’t think that I will accuse you to the Father. There is one who accuses you, even Moses, on whom you have set your hope.

46.text: For if you believed Moses, you would believe me; for he wrote about me.

47.text: But if you don’t believe his writings, how will you believe my words?”

5.text: Jesus therefore lifting up his eyes, and seeing that a great multitude was coming to him, said to Philip, “Where are we to buy bread, that these may eat?”

10.text: Jesus said, “Have the people sit down.” Now there was much grass in that place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.

12.text: When they were filled, he said to his disciples, “Gather up the broken pieces which are left over, that nothing be lost.”

20.text: But he said to them, “It is I. Don’t be afraid.”

26.text: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, you seek me, not because you saw signs, but because you ate of the loaves, and were filled.

27.text: Don’t work for the food which perishes, but for the food which remains to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give to you. For God the Father has sealed him.”

29.text: Jesus answered them, “This is the work of God, that you believe in him whom he has sent.”

32.text: Jesus therefore said to them, “Most certainly, I tell you, it wasn’t Moses who gave you the bread out of heaven, but my Father gives you the true bread out of heaven.

33.text: For the bread of God is that which comes down out of heaven, and gives life to the world.”

35.text: Jesus said to them, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will not be hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.

36.text: But I told you that you have seen me, and yet you don’t believe.

37.text: All those whom the Father gives me will come to me. He who comes to me I will in no way throw out.

38.text: For I have come down from heaven, not to do my own will, but the will of him who sent me.

39.text: This is the will of my Father who sent me, that of all he has given to me I should lose nothing, but should raise him up at the last day.

40.text: This is the will of the one who sent me, that everyone who sees the Son, and believes in him, should have eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.”

43.text: Therefore Jesus answered them, “Don’t murmur among yourselves.

44.text: No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him, and I will raise him up in the last day.

45.text: It is written in the prophets, ‘They will all be taught by God.’ Therefore everyone who hears from the Father and has learned, comes to me.

46.text: Not that anyone has seen the Father, except he who is from God. He has seen the Father.

47.text: Most certainly, I tell you, he who believes in me has eternal life.

48.text: I am the bread of life.

49.text: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness and they died.

50.text: This is the bread which comes down out of heaven, that anyone may eat of it and not die.

51.text: I am the living bread which came down out of heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. Yes, the bread which I will give for the life of the world is my flesh.”

53.text: Jesus therefore said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you don’t have life in yourselves.

54.text: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.

55.text: For my flesh is food indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.

56.text: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood lives in me, and I in him.

57.text: As the living Father sent me, and I live because of the Father; so he who feeds on me, he will also live because of me.

58.text: This is the bread which came down out of heaven—not as our fathers ate the manna, and died. He who eats this bread will live forever.”

61.text: But Jesus knowing in himself that his disciples murmured at this, said to them, “Does this cause you to stumble?

62.text: Then what if you would see the Son of Man ascending to where he was before?

63.text: It is the spirit who gives life. The flesh profits nothing. The words that I speak to you are spirit, and are life.

64.text: But there are some of you who don’t believe.” For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were who didn’t believe, and who it was who would betray him.

65.text: He said, “For this cause I have said to you that no one can come to me, unless it is given to him by my Father.”

67.text: Jesus said therefore to the twelve, “You don’t also want to go away, do you?”

70.text: Jesus answered them, “Didn’t I choose you, the twelve, and one of you is a devil?”

6.text: Jesus therefore said to them, “My time has not yet come, but your time is always ready.

7.text: The world can’t hate you, but it hates me, because I testify about it, that its works are evil.

8.text: You go up to the feast. I am not yet going up to this feast, because my time is not yet fulfilled.”

16.text: Jesus therefore answered them, “My teaching is not mine, but his who sent me.

17.text: If anyone desires to do his will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is from God, or if I am speaking from myself.

18.text: He who speaks from himself seeks his own glory, but he who seeks the glory of him who sent him is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.

19.text: Didn’t Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keeps the law? Why do you seek to kill me?”

21.text: Jesus answered them, “I did one work and you all marvel because of it.

22.text: Moses has given you circumcision (not that it is of Moses, but of the fathers), and on the Sabbath you circumcise a boy.

23.text: If a boy receives circumcision on the Sabbath, that the law of Moses may not be broken, are you angry with me, because I made a man completely healthy on the Sabbath?

24.text: Don’t judge according to appearance, but judge righteous judgment.”

28.text: Jesus therefore cried out in the temple, teaching and saying, “You both know me, and know where I am from. I have not come of myself, but he who sent me is true, whom you don’t know.

29.text: I know him, because I am from him, and he sent me.”

33.text: Then Jesus said, “I will be with you a little while longer, then I go to him who sent me.

34.text: You will seek me, and won’t find me. You can’t come where I am.”

37.text: Now on the last and greatest day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried out, “If anyone is thirsty, let him come to me and drink!

38.text: He who believes in me, as the Scripture has said, from within him will flow rivers of living water.”

12.text: Again, therefore, Jesus spoke to them, saying, “I am the light of the world. He who follows me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”

21.text: Jesus said therefore again to them, “I am going away, and you will seek me, and you will die in your sins. Where I go, you can’t come.”

23.text: He said to them, “You are from beneath. I am from above. You are of this world. I am not of this world.

24.text: I said therefore to you that you will die in your sins; for unless you believe that I am he, you will die in your sins.”

28.text: Jesus therefore said to them, “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am he, and I do nothing of myself, but as my Father taught me, I say these things.

31.text: Jesus therefore said to those Jews who had believed him, “If you remain in my word, then you are truly my disciples.

32.text: You will know the truth, and the truth will make you free.”

34.text: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, everyone who commits sin is the bondservant of sin.

36.text: If therefore the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed.

51.text: Most certainly, I tell you, if a person keeps my word, he will never see death.”

56.text: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day. He saw it, and was glad.”

58.text: Jesus said to them, “Most certainly, I tell you, before Abraham came into existence, I AM.”
